Haverford Trust Company Has Decreased Apple (AAPL) Position By $2.30 Million; Latam Airlines Group S.A. (LTM) Sellers Increased By 7.14% Their Shorts
May 26, 2018 - By Darrin Black
Haverford Trust Company decreased Apple Inc (AAPL) stake by 1.45% reported in 2017Q4 SEC filing. Haverford Trust Company sold 13,636 shares as Apple Inc (AAPL)’s stock declined 3.81%. The Haverford Trust Company holds 928,160 shares with $157.07 million value, down from 941,796 last quarter. Apple Inc now has $926.90 billion valuation. The stock increased 0.23% or $0.43 during the last trading session, reaching $188.58. About 15.45 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Latam Airlines Group S.A. (NYSE:LTM) had an increase of 7.14% in short interest. LTM’s SI was 4.50M shares in May as released by FINRA. Its up 7.14% from 4.20M shares previously. With 400,000 avg volume, 11 days are for Latam Airlines Group S.A. (NYSE:LTM)’s short sellers to cover LTM’s short positions. The SI to Latam Airlines Group S.A.’s float is 1.34%. The stock increased 2.13% or $0.27 during the last trading session, reaching $12.94. About 545,991 shares traded or 3.81% up from the average. LATAM Airlines Group S.A. (NYSE:LTM) has risen 18.24% since May 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 6.69% the S&P500.
Another recent and important LATAM Airlines Group S.A. (NYSE:LTM) news was published by Seekingalpha.com which published an article titled: “LATAM Airlines’ (LTM) CEO Jerome Cadier on Q1 2018 Results – Earnings Call Transcript” on May 13, 2018.
Latam Airlines Group S.A., together with its subsidiaries, provides passenger and cargo air transportation services in South America, North/Central America, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Oceania. The company has market cap of $7.49 billion. The firm operates through two divisions, Air Transportation; and Coalition and Loyalty Program Multiplus. It has a 50.55 P/E ratio. It provides passenger transport services to approximately 150 destinations in 22 countries and cargo services to approximately 169 destinations in 27 countries with a fleet of 310 aircraft.
Haverford Trust Company increased Vanguard Ftse Pacific Etf (VPL) stake by 33,585 shares to 945,914 valued at $68.96M in 2017Q4. It also upped Emerson Electric Co (NYSE:EMR) stake by 5,032 shares and now owns 43,663 shares. Ishares Barclays Intermediate Credit Bond Fund (CIU) was raised too.
